label: PDP Card
title: PDP Card
summary: Use a PDP Card at the top of a product page: the product’s picture, name, two or three key facts, and one action.
corePrinciple: One product, its key facts, one action.

configuration.title: Facts and the action
configuration.description: metrics takes one entry per fact: a title, a value, an optional caption, and an optional icon from the Coin icon set. Entries share the row in equal columns. The card makes its Button small, light purple, and Emphasis Medium, with a plus icon before the label: buttonIcon changes the icon, and null removes it. showButton false removes the button. On the card, AppearanceBrand changes the button and the metric icons, and Emphasis changes the button. media replaces the picture with your own component, and button replaces the Button.

states.title: Its button acts, or the whole card does
states.description: The card isn’t pressable: its button is. onPress makes the whole card one button, named by its title. Use one or the other: a pressable card with its button puts a button inside a button. The card has no disabled, selected, or loading state.

sizing.title: 344 px wide, centred content
sizing.description: The card is 344 px wide, as in Figma; width sets another number or a percentage of its host. Everything inside is centred, 12 px apart, with 20 px of padding at the top and bottom and 16 px at the sides. The picture box is imageWidth × imageHeight, and the height follows the content.

content.title: A name, one qualifier, short facts
content.description: Make the title the product’s name, short enough for one line, and the subtitle one qualifier, such as its purity. Name each fact with a noun, such as Weight or Price, and keep values to a number or a word. Label the button with what it does, such as Add to cart. A title longer than one line is cut with an ellipsis; numberOfLines gives it more lines, and disableTruncation lets it wrap in full.

inContext.description: The card opens the product page, under the page’s heading. Add to cart calls the screen’s own cart through onButtonPress; the card only lays out the product.

sources.title: Use the public PDP Card contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (19 October build of Biscuit’s main) from the team’s private package repository. Its export is PdpCcCard. Figma’s PDP cc card has no component properties; its parts are nested instances. In the package, the divider between metrics has no height on the web, so no line shows (Figma draws one 46 px tall); the button’s plus icon is 18 px where Figma’s is 16; and the card is 316 px tall where Figma’s is 310, because its text lines are taller. Without imageSource an empty box keeps its space, and title and subtitle fall back to the words Title and Subtitle. Every published Storybook story but Title truncation renders the card as a pressable button with its own button inside, and the published page is the older generated one (all reported).
